question: In a code language, 'PAPER' is written as ‘QCSIW’ and ‘BOARD’ is written as ’CQDVI’, how will 'PENCIL' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4df4e878ad25f761a705039f20e93f137c2047a81c6a1ac003e8af17b78b44c.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bcaae2ad2327131e78199ee786e1d52b2e8c1bd14dcacf5a4d8960c7d4b7080.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b96827a7b076e99b2153e7f99221b6b224b1d07db56942b518b0d48c438b8c20.png] 

Hence, '**QGQGNR**' is the correct answer.
